purpose: Defines the runtime acceptance gates for Wardveil evidence delivery into GoreeCloud Mesh without transferring security authority.
required_gates: service credential is minted by GoreeCloud Identity and not self-signed or locally substituted by Wardveil
mesh.evidence.write is the required producer delivery scope
credential lifetime does not exceed 900 seconds
credential kid resolves through the deployed GoreeCloud Identity JWKS endpoint
delivery uses HTTPS except explicit loopback development
delivery refuses HTTP redirects while carrying service identity proof
Mesh base URL contains no user information, query, fragment, or path parameters
submitted envelope passes Mesh provenance and minimization validation
delivery receipt binds to the submitted evidence id
delivery receipt binds to producer_service_id wardveil-security
expired evidence remains auditable but cannot satisfy current-evidence queries
current transport state never upgrades or weakens the Wardveil security outcome
negative_cases: Wardveil mints, self-signs, or substitutes its own Mesh credential
Identity JWKS or live service-token issuance is unavailable
identity proof outside the approved GoreeCloud Identity profile
privacy-shield or everkeep identity attempts Wardveil delivery
redirect response from the configured Mesh endpoint
Mesh base URL contains embedded user information, query, fragment, or path parameters
receipt returns a different evidence id
receipt returns a different producer service id
envelope containing secret material or user content
deployment_boundary: Wardveil delivery support is implemented, but production acceptance requires a deployed GoreeCloud Identity JWKS endpoint and live Identity-issued wardveil-security credentials accepted by GoreeCloud Mesh.
